# Both load gauges present (running + waiting) but cache-usage and prefix-cache
# counters absent — a vLLM scrape where load-aware routing works while the cache
# metrics degrade gracefully. The scraper requires both load gauges, so omitting
# either would fail loud instead.
# HELP vllm:num_requests_running Number of requests currently running.
# TYPE vllm:num_requests_running gauge
vllm:num_requests_running{model_name="m"} 0
# HELP vllm:num_requests_waiting Number of requests waiting.
# TYPE vllm:num_requests_waiting gauge
vllm:num_requests_waiting{model_name="m"} 0
